about: The credential test for seat C (G3 council record 2026-11-17, decision 4; second addendum, decision 2, item 1): scripts/live_eval_fw_reach.py run in the replay job of .github/workflows/live-eval.yml for flow/axil-timer, the same steps, account and tool set as the live-eval job. A C driver test run through fw.test under a parent holding two canaries in its real environment. Result: every probe NOT denied. fw.test builds and runs seat C as the runner, which has passwordless sudo, can write the checkout, the package and the records, and can read the harness's environment with the credential-named canary in it. So a live trial of a case that runs seat C (flow/axi4-lite-regs-driver, firmware/axi4-lite-driver) stays refused (scripts/live_eval_ci.py, exit 6) until fw.test runs seat C as the seat account and this test, run with --require-denied, shows every probe denied.
